```{python}
#| label: ModeGainSVK
#| fig-cap: "Energy gain of each new mode"

import plotly.graph_objects as go
import pandas as pd

# Load the CSV data (one row per converged mode; Gain = relative loss decrease brought by that mode)
try:
    data = pd.read_csv("SVK_lung_6D_greedy_modes.csv")
except:
    data = pd.read_csv("Figures/SVK_lung_6D_greedy_modes.csv")
data = data[data['Modes'] > 1]   # the first mode has a gain of 1 by definition

# Create the figure
fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
    x=data['Modes'], y=data['Gain'],
    name='Gain',
    marker=dict(color='#3a46f5'),
    customdata=data['Iterations'],
    hovertemplate='mode %{x}<br>gain %{y:.1e}<br>%{customdata} iterations<extra></extra>'
))

# Update layout
fig.update_layout(
    plot_bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)',  # Remove background color
    width=450, 
    height=400,  
    xaxis=dict( title='Mode',
                tickvals=[2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12, 14],
                showgrid=False),
    yaxis=dict(
        title=dict(
            text='Relative energy gain', 
            font=dict(color='#170f38')),
        type='log',
        tickvals=[1e-4, 1e-3, 1e-2, 1e-1],
        ticktext=['10⁻⁴', '10⁻³', '10⁻²', '10⁻¹'],
        tickfont=dict(color='#170f38'),
        showgrid=True,
        gridcolor='lightgray', 
    ),
    showlegend=False
)

# Show the figure
fig.show()

```
